## Three steps. Two minutes.

01

### Instrument

Add one decorator to your agent function. Every LLM call, tool invocation, and error is captured automatically.

`@retrace.record(name="my-agent")`

02

### Observe

Watch executions replay in real-time. See the full decision tree — inputs, outputs, costs, timing — in an interactive timeline.

`retrace traces list --json`

03

### Debug

Fork from any failure point. Modify the input. The entire agent re-executes from that decision forward. Find the root cause in seconds.

`retrace forks create --trace `

## Frequently asked

How long does setup take?+

Under 2 minutes. Install the SDK, add one decorator, and traces stream immediately. No infrastructure to manage.

What languages and providers are supported?+

Python and TypeScript SDKs with auto-instrumentation for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini. Works with any agent framework — LangChain, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK, AutoGen, LlamaIndex.

How does fork & replay work?+

Select any span in a trace, modify its input, and Retrace cascade-replays from that point forward. Context from the fork flows into subsequent LLM calls. You get a side-by-side diff with cost and latency deltas.

What are guardrails?+

Runtime policies that monitor your agent in real-time. Set cost budgets, loop detection, context overflow limits, or latency caps. When violated, the agent receives a HALT command via WebSocket — stopping it before damage cascades.

Is my data secure?+

TLS in transit, encrypted at rest. API keys are SHA-256 hashed. PII auto-redaction for Teams/Enterprise. Row-level security in PostgreSQL. SOC 2 compliance in progress.

Can I use this in CI/CD?+

Yes. The eval gate endpoint (POST /evaluations/:id/gate) returns pass/fail with a threshold. The CLI command `retrace eval gate` exits with code 1 on failure — perfect for GitHub Actions.

How is this different from LangSmith?+

LangSmith shows traces in a UI. Retrace lets you fork from any decision and cascade-replay the entire agent. Plus runtime guardrails, hallucination detection, and causal inference — none of which LangSmith offers.

Does it work with multi-agent systems?+

Yes. Each span carries an agent_id. Sessions group multi-turn conversations. The graph endpoint shows cross-agent causal ordering using vector clocks.

## Stop guessing. Start replaying.

Your agent failed 3 steps before the error surfaced. Fork from the real cause — not the symptom.
